faq.q1: Iyini i-World Changers Mental Health Care Organisation?
faq.a1: I-World Changers Mental Health Care Organisation iyinhlangano engenzi nzuzo ebhalisiwe yaseNingizimu Afrika (NPO 238-677) neyi-Public Benefit Organisation (PBO 930084594) ezinze eGoli. Senza ukunakekelwa kwempilo yengqondo okusezingeni eliphezulu nokunesithunzi kufinyeleleke kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Afrika ngokweluleka okuhleliwe okwenziwa nge-inthanethi kanye nezinhlelo zenhlalakahle zomphakathi.
faq.a2: Sinikeza ukwelulekwa komuntu ngamunye, ukwelapha izithandani nemindeni, ukusekelwa kwezingane nentsha, ukwelulekwa ngenxeba nokusizwa ngokuzila, kanye nezimfundiso zempilo yengqondo nezingqungquthela zempilontle zezikole, izinhlangano nemiphakathi. Ukunakekela kufudumele, kuyimfihlo futhi kwenzelwe izidingo zakho.
faq.q3: Ngiwubhukha kanjani umhlangano noma ngiluthole kanjani usizo?
faq.a3: Iya ekhasini lethu le-Mental Health, ukhethe umsebenzi wezempilo omthandayo, bese ugcwalisa isicelo esifushane sokubhukha. Ithimba lethu liyakuqinisekisa ukubhukha kwakho kwe-inthanethi nge-imeyili noma ngocingo. Ungasishayela ucingo futhi — wonke umhlangano ubhukhwa ngokwesikhathi.
faq.a4: Yebo. Njengenhlangano exhaswa ngeminikelo eyi-Public Benefit Organisation, sinikeza ukwelulekwa kwe-inthanethi mahhala ukuze izindleko zingabi yisithiyo sokuthola usizo. Awudingi umshwalense wezempilo noma i-inshorensi ukuze ubhukhe nathi.
faq.q5: Ingabe imihlangano yenziwa nge-inthanethi noma ubuso nobuso?
faq.a5: Imihlangano yenziwa nge-inthanethi ngoxhumano lwevidiyo oluphephile, ngokubhukha, ngakho ungathola usizo noma ukuphi eNingizimu Afrika. Umhlangano ngamunye uthatha cishe imizuzu engu-60.
faq.a6: Izinsizakalo zethu zivulekele izingane, intsha nabantu abadala, kanye nemindeni, izithandani, izikole, izinhlangano namaqembu omphakathi — kungakhathaliseki isizinda. Wonke umuntu wamukelekile.
faq.a7: Umhlangano wakho wokuqala uyingxoxo ekhululekile mayelana nokuthi yini ekulethe ekwelulekweni, izinjongo zakho, nokuthi singakusiza kanjani. Umeluleki wakho uzokuchazela ngobumfihlo aphendule noma yimiphi imibuzo. Kuyithuba futhi lokubona ukuthi uzizwa ukhululekile yini ukusebenza ndawonye.
faq.a8: Yebo. Konke okwabelanayo kuphathwa njengokuyimfihlo futhi kulawulwa ngokuhambisana nomthetho i-Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) nezindinganiso zokuziphatha zochwepheshe. Ubumfihlo bunciphiswa kuphela lapho kunengozi yokulimala kuwe noma kwabanye, lapho kusolwa ukuhlukunyezwa noma ukunganakwa, noma lapho amarekhodi edingwa ngumthetho.
faq.q9: Ngingazi kanjani ukuthi kufanele ngicele ukwelulekwa?
faq.a9: Awudingi ukuba usenkingeni ukuze ufune usizo. Uma udlula kokungapheli kokudabuka, ukukhathazeka, ingcindezi, ukuzila, izinkinga zobudlelwano, ihlazo lengozi, noma nje uzizwa ukhungathekile noma ungakwazi ukubhekana nazo, ukwelulekwa kungasiza.
faq.a10: I-World Changers inikeza ukunakekela okuhleliwe okusekelwe ekubhukheni — asisona isevisi yezimo eziphuthumayo yamahora angu-24. Uma wena noma omunye umuntu usengozini esheshayo, shayela u-112 (umugqa wezimo eziphuthumayo kazwelonke) noma u-10177 (i-ambulensi), noma uye esibhedlela esiseduze nawe egumbini lezimo eziphuthumayo. Ungathola futhi i-SADAG Suicide Crisis Helpline emahhala engu-24/7 ku-0800 567 567.
faq.q10: Kufanele ngenzeni uma ngisenkingeni ephuthumayo manje?
faq.a11: Singathanda usizo lwakho. Vakashela ikhasi lethu i-Become a Volunteer bese ugcwalisa ifomu lokubhalisa — ithimba lethu libuyekeza zonke izicelo futhi lizoxhumana nawe. Kunezindlela zombili zokubamba iqhaza, ezobuso nobuso nezikude.
faq.q12: Isikole sami, inkampani noma inhlangano yami ingaba kanjani umlingani wenu?
faq.a12: Siyabamukela ubudlelwano nezikole, amabhizinisi, ama-NGO nabaxhasi — kusukela ezingqungqutheleni zempilontle kuya emphakathini nasekuxhaseni. Vakashela ikhasi lethu le-Partnerships noma uxhumane nathi ukuze sihlolisise ukusebenza ndawonye.
faq.q13: Nginganikela kanjani, futhi ingabe umnikelo wami uyakwehliswa entelankokhelo?
faq.a13: Unganikela ngokuphephile ngekhadi nge-Paystack noma nge-EFT — kanye noma nyanga zonke. Njenge-PBO ebhalisiwe, sikhipha irisidi ye-Section 18A yokwehliswa entelankokhelo (ngaphakathi kwamahora angu-48), ongayisebenzisa ngezinjongo zentela ze-SARS. Wonke umnikelo usiza ukugcina ukwelulekwa kwethu kumahhala.
faq.a14: Sithumele i-imeyili ku-info@worldchangersmh.org noma ushayele ihhovisi lethu lokuphatha ngamahora okusebenza (uMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu). Njengenhlangano eqala nge-inthanethi, sisekela abantu kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Afrika — indlela esheshayo yokuqala yifomu lokubhukha ekhasini lethu le-Mental Health.
